entry_points.text: Each CPU exposes preferred fault-mode defaulting to async with serialized updates rejecting unknown text. Early fixup turns one branch to no-op when tagging is on.
Override entry clears storage, records boot status, consumes cmdlines and flushes. Randomization honors disable, uses firmware seed or hardware randomness, else zero.
Host checker maps file, detects endian mismatch, rewrites absolute entries in place-relative data to relative form, rejects elsewhere, deletes file and exits nonzero on failure.

exports.text: Privileged checking offers sync, async, asymmetric and store-only enables with promotion. User control translates requests against per-CPU preference and refreshes live registers with fallback.
Page compare forces inequality for tagged pages at different addresses. Thread create, switch and suspend clear fault status, refresh controls and disable override.
Tracer tag access uses one vector with aligned target, checks support and permission, walks tag-enabled pages marking dirty; low helpers move tags tolerating user faults.
Stolen-time query samples the per-CPU counter returning zero when unpublished. Init probes support, installs handlers, redirects the clock and honors a boot option.
Instruction memory supports aligned copy and fill. PCI config delegates to bus ops with not-found handling; node lookup delegates to its device.
Callchain sampling skips guests, records PC and walks frames until consumer stops. Generic walker forwards via adapter. Register helpers give values, checks, ABI and capture.
Early mapping builds tables for identity, FDT and displaced kernel maps. SCS validates frames, relocation applies displacement, key control reseeds keys.

hazards.text: Uses external percpu, atomics, memory, copy, fault, warning and compat helpers owned elsewhere, cited without describing internals.
Uses external bit, ELF, compiler, alignment, warning and preemption helpers owned elsewhere, cited without describing internals.

invariants.text: User unwinding checks access and alignment, copies atomically with faults disabled, strips authentication and needs ascending pointers; compat adjusts for smaller layout.
Filters guard host, range, vector, matrix and extension overrides. Aliases map friendly spellings to canonical assignments once; values are one hex digit.
Override source prefers boot args over built-in unless forced. Seed reads one eight-byte property, clears after use and returns zero when missing; displacement is centered.
Segments span inclusive start to exclusive end; unmapping reuses the path empty. Non-global mappings are denied only on two erratum families.
Rewriting swaps only two authenticated-return words for shadow-stack forms and cleans the line. Skipping passes continuation bytes; formats select four or eight byte addresses.
Enablement keeps a saved word, translates selectors with warnings, updates with preemption disabled and immediate push, and rebuilds the public mask on query.

locks.text: Text updates serialize on a raw spinlock with IRQs saved, rewrite in page chunks via temp mapping unmapped per chunk, and flush icache after unlock.

state_machines.text: Discovery queries features; each online CPU requests, maps and validates its record then publishes. Offline clears, waits for readers and unmaps; failures report cleanly.
Patching runs a callback on all online CPUs; last arrival writes all words then releases the rest, early arrivals spin then order; empty counts are rejected.
Matching scans for a prefix hit, encoding filtered values with cleared coverage else setting value and coverage. Cmdline scan skips blanks, stops at double dash and expands aliases once.
Kernel mapping selects protections, maps, handles relocatable images with temp switch and republish. LPA2 builds a provisional map, rebuilds original, switches back and erases scratch.
Frame walk tracks address, advances by scaled deltas, skips definition operands, ignores high ranges, rewrites on toggle; unknown codes fail. Ops cover advances and negation.

structs.text: Per-CPU stolen state is one RCU pointer initially empty. Patch descriptor holds parallel dest and word arrays with count and arrival counter electing one writer.
Override descriptor pairs register name with override reference and fields of name, shift, width and validator. Name sizes are twenty, ten, thirty and 116; width defaults to four.
Frame storage starts with length where zero ends and all-ones is rejected, then a discriminator selecting header or description with 32 or 64 bit ranges.
Relative refs store signed displacements yielding null for zero else adding to their address. Reserved mask covers bits at and above the base count.
